reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for L-carnitine. Dosing for any supplement is a call for a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can factor in your health, your medications and what you're after.

In general terms, it's a compound your body makes on its own and is also sold as a supplement. The research on it for fat loss or performance is mixed, and food, sleep and consistent training move the needle far more.

If you tell me what you're hoping it does for you, I can point you to what helps on the training side.
